name: 1 GiB reserved without backing, then one page committed inside it
component: ground-truth pairing for the Windows reserve/commit model on a POSIX host
required_postconditions: the reservation is a distinct observable state and the commit step is a call whose failure the program can detect

failure_sink.description: the case reports the refusal and the runner fails the pairing

extraction_limitations: Single-claim contract written to pair with a ground-truth case. It asserts exactly one thing so that a whole-contract verdict can be compared against a single observation without ambiguity.
x_groundtruth: What this case CANNOT show is the part that bites: that no error arrives when the host is out of memory. Provoking that means exhausting the runner.
